snippet.title: Version 4.7 Trailer: "Now, Lay Laughter to All Stars" | Honkai: Star Rail
snippet.description:
In the maddening silence, a voice said: "Laugh, and let THEM hear your existence." And thus, the stars were silent no more, pouring all their radiance into a single burst of laughter.
※ This video contains content in development. Please refer to the official launch version for final content.
